data.name: Amyria
data.detailed_description:
Amyria is a sandbox action RPG set in a reimagined fantasy Age of Exploration. Be an explorer, a diplomat, a schemer, a thief, or something entirely your own in a fully simulated world where every NPC is alive.

Play solo or with friends.

Welcome to the New World

Amyria is a newly discovered continent where rival powers scramble for dominance. Ambition, corruption, discovery, and danger lurk around every corner. Ports bustle with rumor and opportunity. Factions rise and fall. People chase power in ways noble, desperate, and ruthless.

Characters that Don't Pretend

NPCs understand the world around them. Every character in Amyria is an intelligent and humanlike NPC, with their own backstory and goals. 

Speak freely to anyone.

Type or say anything, and characters react based on their personality and knowledge of you. You can persuade, negotiate, deceive, threaten, or build trust. Your words matter, and people remember them.

A World that Lives

Leaders can fall, factions can fracture, and towns can flourish or fade away. In Amyria, your actions can influence the world in unscripted ways:

  • Remove a key figure and watch new power struggles emerge.

  • Disrupt local economies and see conflict or opportunity follow.

  • Rumors of your exploits travel through taverns and marketplaces, changing how strangers greet you long before you arrive.

Meanwhile, NPCs pursue their own goals, form alliances, settle grudges, and react to global events, even when you’re adventuring on the other side of the continent.

Multiple Playstyles, Your Call

  • Melee: Swordplay based on timing and positioning

  • Ranged: Flintlocks, muskets, and crossbows

  • Magic: Rare, dangerous, and feared

  • Stealth: Slip past undetected or eliminate silently

Mix them however you want. Talk your way in, throw a fireball, snipe the guards. Your approach, your rules.

You Are Not the Chosen One

In Amyria, destiny is earned. Who you become is determined entirely by the choices you make.

Be honorable or ruthless. Lead, trade, explore, deceive, or manipulate. Your identity is shaped entirely by the actions you take, and the ones you avoid.

Every quest you accept or ignore has consequences.

  • Destroy a military camp and you may become a liberator to one faction and a terrorist to another.

  • Help a shy villager ask someone out, and you may later find them married.

  • Refuse to help a desperate farmer with a bandit problem, and you may later hear rumors of his fate.

Violence is a choice. Mercy is a choice. Inaction is a choice.

And the world will remember all of them.

Play How you Want

Choose your path, alone or with friends.
Amyria supports singleplayer and co-op for up to four players, letting you shape the world together.

Customize your experience.

For players who love to create their own stories, Steam Workshop support is in active development, enabling the community to add new content to Amyria.

data.short_description: A fully simulated action RPG where every character has a story, and your actions have real consequences. Factions rise and fall, loyalties shift, and the world evolves with or without you. Play solo or with friends.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: The game offers extensive graphics settings to support a wide range of hardware.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / GTX 1080, or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Includes advanced graphics settings for players with powerful hardware.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains mature themes such as gore and drug use. Excessive gore or violence is omitted. Alcohol and Tobacco are depicted, but real-world illegal drug use is not present.
